# Monetization (Phases 1–3)

Goal: affiliate income from launch, premium and sponsored placement in v1, B2B data later. The consumer core stays free, and **money never buys rank**.

---

## 10.1 Affiliate links (Phase 1)

- Apply now (Phase 0) to: Jumia affiliate program, Konga affiliate program, Temu affiliate program; later AliExpress/Shein programs. Record status, rates, cookie windows and link formats in `docs/build/AFFILIATES.md` once approved.
- `stores.affiliate` jsonb: `{ network, linkTemplate, subIdParam, active }`.
- `/go/:listingId` builds the outbound URL: listing URL → affiliate template with sub-id = `clickId` (the `clicks.id` generated by `/go`, see `08-user-side.md` 8.4).
- Monthly reconciliation script: import network reports (CSV), match sub-ids to clicks, compute revenue per store/category/search source in `scripts/out/revenue-YYYYMM.md`.
- Disclose: "Cheapa may earn a commission when you buy through links. Prices and order are never affected." on results and `/affiliate-disclosure`.

## 10.2 Sponsored placement (v1)

- One "Featured seller" slot per product page, below the organic cheapest listing, clearly labelled "Sponsored".
- Only for stores already listing that exact product at a price within 10% of the cheapest.
- Simple monthly flat fee to start (invoice via Paystack), self-serve later.

## 10.3 Cheapa Premium (v1)

| Feature | Free | Premium |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Snap/share/text search | Unlimited (fair use) | Unlimited |
| Price watches | 5 | Unlimited |
| Alerts | Push + email, throttled | Instant, plus WhatsApp |
| Deal digests by category | Weekly | Daily |
| Price history | 30 days | Full history |

Billing: Paystack subscriptions (naira), managed from web to avoid app-store fees where store rules allow; in-app purchase on iOS if required by App Store rules. Price to be set after watching v1 usage.

## 10.4 B2B price intelligence (Phase 3)

- Brand dashboard: where their products are listed, at what price, who undercuts, stock status, price history.
- Data API: aggregated price indexes by category (phones, laptops, groceries) for media, investors and FMCG firms.
- Only aggregated catalog data. **Never user data.**
- Pricing per brand per month; start with 3–5 design partners.

## 10.5 Unit-economics guardrails (lean budget)

- Track cost per search (vision LLM + compute) vs revenue per search (affiliate) weekly.
- If cost per search > revenue per search for 2 weeks: raise cache TTL, require sign-in after N anonymous searches/day, or switch vision provider per the benchmark.
